title: THE SINKHOLE · title page
venue: The Unprinted · a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for, found in Box 5 in the private years
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. not mine. keep.

panels.composition: A Sunday section's front in a line almost his: the florid masthead, a dateline in blocks, the fold crease straight through the title, and beneath it the section logo drawn large — a small town street opening into a ragged hole seen from directly above, a riverboat's deck tilting into it — with the rest of the page's columns as gray blocks.

image.prompt: black and white newspaper Sunday comic section front in a brush line almost but not quite the strip's own, a florid serif masthead with a dateline drawn as blocks and a fold crease through it, a large circular section logo of a town street opening into a ragged hole seen from above with a riverboat tilting into it, columns of text drawn as gray blocks
image.notes: Not his. In his box. The title page is the only page with legible words on it, and they're the paper's, not his.
